sentences.zh: 由於軌道是橢圓形的，行星和太陽之間的距離不會總是相同。
sentences.en: Since the orbits are elliptical, the planets do not always have the same distance from the Sun.

sentences.zh: 現在我們什麼也做不了，救不了湯姆。我們唯一能做的就是祈禱。
sentences.en: There's nothing we can do to save Tom at this point. All we can do is pray.

sentences.zh: 許多父母認為讓自己的子女在下午八點前吃完飯是很重要的。
sentences.en: Many parents think it's important for their children to eat before 8:00 p.m.

sentences.zh: 如果看起来像个苹果而且吃起来也像苹果的话，可能就是苹果。
sentences.en: If it looks like an apple and it tastes like an apple, it's probably an apple.

sentences.zh: 我不喜歡生日那天湯姆送我的那件襯衫，所以我把它給了約翰。
sentences.en: I didn't like the shirt that Tom gave me for my birthday, so I gave it to John.

sentences.zh: 455名婦女中會有一名直到懷孕第二十週前沒有意識到自己懷孕。
sentences.en: One out of 455 women doesn't realize she's pregnant until the twentieth week of pregnancy.

sentences.zh: 伯拉罕·林肯，美国第16任总统，生于肯塔基州的一个简陋的小屋里。
sentences.en: Abraham Lincoln, the 16th president of the United States, was born in a log cabin in Kentucky.

sentences.zh: 山谷中，薄霧如白色羽毛般緩緩升騰，化作一團白雲，遮蔽了一切。
sentences.en: Down in the valley a mist like a white feather rose gently into a white cloud, and obscured everything.

sentences.zh: 我母亲的法语比我父亲的英语要好，所以他们通常用法语交流。
sentences.en: My mother speaks French better than my father speaks English, so they usually speak to each other in French.

sentences.zh: 你很容易把母语说得通顺流畅，却很容易把非母语说得不自然。
sentences.en: It's very easy to sound natural in your own native language, and very easy to sound unnatural in your non-native language.

sentences.zh: 坚持做对的事情。这会满足一部分人同时使另一部分人感到惊讶。
sentences.en: Always do right. This will gratify some people and astonish the rest.

sentences.zh: 假如能回到过去让人生再来一遍的话，你希望能回到几岁的时候？
sentences.en: If you could go back and start your life again, from what age would you like to start?

sentences.zh: 无论我们是否喜欢电脑，它在我们的生活中始终起着重要的作用。
sentences.en: Computers are certainly playing an important role in our life, whether we like it or not.

sentences.zh: 我喜欢这幅画，不仅是因为它的名气，而是因为它真的是一个杰作。
sentences.en: I like this picture, not just because it's famous, but because it really is a masterpiece.

sentences.zh: 由於它的起源，加拿大英語具有美國英語和​​英國英語兩者的特色。
sentences.en: Because of its origins, Canadian English has features of both American and British English.

sentences.zh: 在日本，在我们的雨季常常下雨，雨季一般在六月中旬至七月中旬。
sentences.en: In Japan, it rains quite a bit during our rainy season which is from mid-June until mid-July.

sentences.zh: 湯姆逐漸了解到，用又大又薄的鏟子翻煎餅或馬鈴薯餅效果最好。
sentences.en: Tom has come to know that a large, thin spatula works best for turning over pancakes or latkes.

sentences.zh: 汤姆不知如何翻译“计算机”一词，因为同他谈话的人从未见过一台。
sentences.en: Tom didn't know how to translate the word "computer" because the people he was talking to had never seen one.

sentences.zh: 蓋上鍋蓋煮至洋蔥變軟，然後揭開鍋蓋繼續煮至洋蔥呈現淺棕色。
sentences.en: Cover the pan and cook until tender, then remove the cover and continue the cooking until the onions are a light brown.

sentences.zh: 我知道汤姆会成为一位优秀的篮球教练。这就是为什么我聘用了他。
sentences.en: I knew Tom would be a good basketball coach. That's why I hired him.

sentences.zh: 她被要求去说服他以让他或者他的儿子或者是别的人来粉刷屋子。
sentences.en: She was asked to convince him to get his son or someone else to paint the house.

sentences.zh: 作為一個良好的交談者，並不只意味著作一個英語說得好的說話者。
sentences.en: Being a good conversationalist does not just mean being a good speaker of English.

sentences.zh: 我們需要人力仲介公司幫我們找到合適的人來擔任這個管理職位。
sentences.en: We'll need a head hunting agency to find the right man for this executive position.

sentences.zh: 汤姆的妈妈是一名护士，她所在的医院就在玛丽住的那条街的对面。
sentences.en: Tom's mother is a nurse at the hospital that's across the street from where Mary lives.

sentences.zh: 如果一个人有11只羊，除了9只之外，其他全部死了，那么他还剩下几只羊呢？
sentences.en: If a man had 11 sheep and all but 9 died, how many sheep would he have left?

sentences.zh: 如果我們應該少聽多說話, 那麼我們應該得到兩個嘴巴一隻耳朵才是。
sentences.en: If we were supposed to talk more than listen, we would have been given two mouths and one ear.

sentences.zh: 這裡除了惡劣的天氣和頻繁的地震之外，幾乎就是一個完美的居住地。
sentences.en: Except for the bad weather and the frequent earthquakes, this is almost a perfect place to live.

sentences.zh: 当汤姆开着他破旧的雷泽车来接女儿放学时，他的女儿假装不认识他。
sentences.en: Tom's daughter pretended not to know him when he came to pick her up from school in his battered old car.

sentences.zh: 虽然我被公司解雇了，但是我还有点存款，所以目前不用担心生计问题。
sentences.en: I got fired from the company, but since I have a little money saved up, for the time being, I won't have trouble with living expenses.

sentences.zh: 在人际交往中，第一印象决定着将要发生的事情内容的百分之五十以上。
sentences.en: When people meet, first impressions determine more than 50 percent of whatever happens next.

sentences.zh: 汤姆试过还回泳衣来换成更大一号的，但是员工告诉他那是不被允许的。
sentences.en: Tom tried to return the swimsuit for a larger size, but the clerk told him that wasn't allowed.

sentences.zh: 在十九世纪三十年代的大萧条时期，许多富人在股市崩盘中失去了一切。
sentences.en: During the Depression in the 1930's, many wealthy people lost everything in the stock market crash.

sentences.zh: 這個工人本來應該在中午十二點到達, 但他被交通堵塞困住了幾個小時。
sentences.en: The handyman was supposed to arrive at twelve noon, but got stuck in a traffic jam for a few hours.

sentences.zh: 假如你在老师讲课的时候再集中一点去听讲的话，你应该就能弄明白了。
sentences.en: If you'd listen a little more carefully to what the teacher says, you'd probably be able to understand.

sentences.zh: 许多自然环境保护主义者担心持续屠杀鲸鱼正推动这些动物走向灭绝。
sentences.en: Many conservationists fear the continuing slaughter of whales is pushing these animals towards extinction.

sentences.zh: 即使是现在，我偶尔还是想见到你。不是今天的你，而是我记忆中曾经的你。
sentences.en: Even now, I occasionally think I'd like to see you. Not the you that you are today, but the you I remember from the past.

sentences.zh: 剛開始的時候你可能不會喜歡這個啤酒。這是需要多次品嚐去習慣它的口味。
sentences.en: You might not like this beer at first. It's an acquired taste.

sentences.zh: “又是汤姆的电话？” “嗯。最近他每天晚上都会打过来。当时就不该给他我的号码的。”
sentences.en: "Is that Tom calling again?" "Yes. He calls every evening these days. I shouldn't have given him my number."

sentences.zh: 汤姆不喜欢使用”有色人种“这个术语，因为他认为，根据这种说法白种人没有颜色。
sentences.en: Tom doesn't like to use the term "a person of color" because he thinks it implies that white people have no color.

sentences.zh: 每天早上吃一隻活青蛙, 那麼你一天中其他的時間就不會發生什麼更糟糕的事了。
sentences.en: Eat a live frog every morning, and nothing worse will happen to you the rest of the day.

sentences.zh: 我建立了部落格。我會儘量努力，不想成為那種只在初期短暫活躍發文，然後就放棄的人。
sentences.en: I started a new blog. I'll do my best not to be one of those people who blogs a lot right at the start and then quits blogging.

sentences.zh: 就像马克·诺弗勒早期演唱的歌曲《金钱无用》一样，绝大多数的人依然高呼赞成“金钱无用论”。
sentences.en: The large crowd roared in approval as Mark Knopfler played the first few bars of "Money for Nothing".

sentences.zh: 如果一個人在成人前沒有機會習得目標語言，他對該語言的認識達到母語者程度的機會是相當小的。
sentences.en: If a person has not had a chance to acquire his target language by the time he's an adult, he's unlikely to be able to reach native speaker level in that language.
